string.name: write_media_reason
string.value: Saves exported edits and photos received or downloaded from your camera to the system gallery

string.name: wifi_reason
string.value: Reads the camera hotspot and, after your confirmation, switches to the camera Wi-Fi for transfer and control

string.name: location_reason
string.value: Scans for the camera Wi-Fi hotspot nearby (the system requires location access to list surrounding networks)

string.name: bluetooth_reason
string.value: Discovers the LUMIX camera via Bluetooth and completes the pairing and Wi-Fi handshake

string.name: device_id_reason
string.value: Keeps the camera pairing identity stable across app reinstalls
